items.h: Taking part in practice Tuesday
items.s: McCarthy (hip) was spotted on the field for the media-access portion of Tuesday's practice, Art Stapleton of The Bergen Record reports. Listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate when the Giants merely held a walkthrough, McCarthy looks poised to take more on-field reps Tuesday. Whether that translates into a "full" listing won't be known until the Giants release their second injury report of the week once Tuesday's practice concludes, but McCarthy's presence on the field is nonetheless a positive sign ahead of Thursday's game against the Commanders. McCarthy dealt with a hip pointer during the Giants' Week 9 win over the Eagles, but he was able to finish out the game…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy (hip) practices Tuesday
items.s: J.J. McCarthy was practicing on Tuesday. McCarthy remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Commanders.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Participating in Practice on Tuesday
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (hip) was participating in the portion of practice open to the media on Tuesday, per The North Jersey Bergen Record's Art Stapleton. McCarthy is back on the field after the Giants listed him as a limited participant during their walkthrough practice on Monday. The 23-year-old former 10th overall pick by the Minnesota Vikings in 2024 from Michigan is trending in the right direction for the Thursday night contest against the division-rival Washington Commanders after injuring his hip in the third quarter of Sunday's win over the division-rival Philadelphia Eagles. McCarthy looked to be in a lot of pain on the sideline, but he eventually checked back…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Emerging as Strong Week 10 Waiver-Wire Option
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy exited Sunday's contest against Philadelphia with a hip injury after taking a hard hit to the area, but returned to the contest, and reports have suggested he is expected to play in Week 10 against the Commanders. Since taking over as the Giants quarterback after the Vikings traded him for a fifth-round pick, he has looked the part, ranking 91st percentile in completion percentage over expectations, 97th percentile in yards per attempt, and 89th percentile in catchable throw rate. Complete night-and-day difference from his time in Minnesota. Washington is vulnerable to the passing game, evidenced by them allowing the fourth-most fantasy points per…

items.h: Managing hip issue
items.s: McCarthy (hip) is listed as limited on Monday's practice estimate, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports. McCarthy exited Sunday's win at Philadelphia for a spell in the third quarter due to a hip injury but returned to action. Head coach John Harbaugh told Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News on Monday that McCarthy has a hip pointer but is expected to play Thursday versus the Commanders. McCarthy likely will need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday to head into Week 10 action without a designation.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy (hip) expected to be ready for Thursday's game
items.s: Giants QB JJ McCarthy suffered a hip pointer during Sunday's win in Philadelphia, but he is expected to be ready for Thursday's game against the Commanders. McCarthy left Sunday's game with the injury before he later returned to the field. It is a short week for the Giants, but he is still expected to be ready to go for another divisional matchup.

items.h: Likely to play Thursday, despite hip pointer
items.s: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Monday that McCarthy is managing a hip pointer but is expected to play Thursday against the Commanders, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports. "It does look like he's gonna play," Harbaugh said. "I feel fairly good about it." During Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles, McCarthy exited with just over 12 minutes left in the third quarter due to the hip issue and appeared to be in significant discomfort while attempting to test out the injury by throwing on the sideline. Backup Jameis Winston stepped in to finish out the Giants' possession and directed another drive before McCarthy was able to check back into the contest for the final play of the…

items.h: Will Isaiah Likely remain an elite fantasy TE with J.J. McCarthy at QB?
J.J. McCarthy scoreless in win Sunday
items.s: J.J. McCarthy completed 12-of-19 passing attempts for 127 yards and added 22 yards on the ground in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. McCarthy left Sunday's game at one point after suffering a hip injury. The team cleared him to return, however, and he was able to finish the game and lead the Giants to a win over Philadelphia on the road. Still, he didn't score a single touchdown over the course of the game, which left him with a poor fantasy total when all was said and done.

items.h: Giants Optimistic J.J. McCarthy Can Play Thursday
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (hip) is trending toward playing Thursday night against the Washington Commanders. "I feel fairly good about it," head coach John Harbaugh said, according to Pat Leonard. McCarthy missed most of the third quarter of Sunday's win over the Philadelphia Eagles before the Giants' medical staff cleared him to return. He scrambled 11 yards for a first down in the fourth quarter and said afterward he still felt the effects of the injury on that run. He finished 12 of 19 for 127 yards and added 22 yards on four carries. McCarthy hasn't thrown a touchdown pass in two starts for New York, though he ran for a score in his first start against the Houston…

items.h: Can Isaiah Likely remain an elite fantasy TE with J.J. McCarthy at QB?
Ineffective in Week 9 win
items.s: McCarthy (hip) completed 12 of 19 passes for 127 yards and rushed four times for 22 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles. McCarthy left the game in the third quarter due to a hip injury, and Jameis Winston led the Giants' only touchdown drive of the game before McCarthy checked back in on the following possession. Winston's small-sample success Sunday probably won't be enough to wrestle the starting role back from McCarthy, but McCarthy's Week 10 availability could be in question with a short week to recover before the Giants host the Commanders on Thursday. It wasn't pretty, but the 5-2-1 Giants maintained some breathing room in the NFC East, even with the Cowboys improving to 4-5,…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy leaves game after taking hard hit
Back in Sunday's game
items.s: McCarthy (hip) returned to Sunday's contest at Philadelphia, Connor Hughes of SNY.tv reports. McCarthy exited Week 9 action for a spell in the third quarter due to a hip injury, but it couldn't keep him from coming back on to the field near the end of that period. Barring a setback, he'll look to finish out the game.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy (hip) questionable to return
items.s: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy (hip) is questionable to return against the Eagles. McCarthy went into the locker room after taking a hard hit on a rushing attempt. Jameis Winston will likely quarterback the Giants the rest of the way.

items.h: Injures hip in Week 9
items.s: McCarthy suffered a hip injury during Sunday's game in Philadelphia. McCarthy was on the receiving end of a big hit from Eagles linebacker Zack Baun in the third quarter and was in clear pain as he went to the sideline tent, and eventually, the locker room. The nature of the issue is known, but considering McCarthy is questionable to return, he still has a chance to reenter the contest. Jameis Winston has taken over for McCarthy under center.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy in the medical tent
items.s: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy is currently on the sideline in the medical tent being evaluated for an injury. McCarthy was apparently injured on a short rushing attempt in which he took a helmet into his side. The broadcast showed McCarthy attempting to throw on the sideline and he was clearly in pain. Jameis Winston is currently in at quarterback for the Giants.

items.h: Visits sideline tent Sunday
items.s: McCarthy (undisclosed) went to the blue medical tent during Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports. McCarthy took a big hit to the midsection from Eagles linebacker Zack Baun in the third quarter and was in obvious discomfort as he went to the sideline. The nature of McCarthy's injury isn't known, but Jameis Winston will fill in for him for as long as he's out of the contest.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Returns Against Eagles After Hip Injury
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (hip) returned to Sunday's Week 9 game against the Philadelphia Eagles on the final play of the third quarter. McCarthy had been listed as questionable after taking a hit from Eagles linebacker Zack Baun on a designed run earlier in the quarter. Before leaving, McCarthy completed nine of 13 passes for 101 yards and ran three times for 11 yards. Jameis Winston led a 14-play, 76-yard drive in McCarthy's absence and threw a five-yard touchdown pass to Isaiah Likely to put the Giants ahead.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Questionable to Return Against Eagles
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (hip) is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 9 game against the Philadelphia Eagles, according to Jordan Raanan. McCarthy took a hit from Eagles linebacker Zack Baun on a designed run early in the third quarter. He tried to throw on the sideline and fell to the ground before being evaluated in the medical tent and heading to the locker room. Jameis Winston took over for New York. Before exiting, McCarthy completed nine of 13 passes for 101 yards and added 11 yards on three carries.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Hoping for More Touchdown Luck Against Eagles
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy led the team to victory in Week 7 and will look to carry that momentum into Week 9. In five quarters with the Giants, McCarthy has completed 31 of 49 pass attempts for 495 yards, with one touchdown and one interception. In Week 7, McCarthy totaled 252 passing yards but did not throw a touchdown, while running backs Cam Skattebo, Tyrone Tracy Jr., Devin Singletary, and even backup Jameis Winston scored rushing touchdowns. McCarthy will hope for better touchdown luck against the Philadelphia Eagles defense, which has allowed the ninth-most fantasy points to quarterbacks this season. Injuries have plagued the Eagles on both sides of the ball, so the…

He has rushed five times for 29 yards in three games since joining the Giants. McCarthy is currently rostered in just 9% of…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Worth a Speculative Waiver Addition
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy was written off in Minnesota and traded for a measly 2027 fifth-round pick. That trade looks like a bargain. Since joining the Giants, he's thrown for 495 yards on just 49 throws, an absurd 10.1 yards per attempt. He threw for 243 yards in late relief against New Orleans in Week 6 and 252 yards against Houston in Week 7. So far, his stats have been excellent, and his game tape may be even more impressive. However, you should still approach him with some caution. After 178 yards in the first half against Houston, he only managed 65 in the second half. All that yardage and still only one TD. Making matters worse, the Giants brought in Jameis Winston…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy impresses through air Sunday
items.s: J.J. McCarthy completed 20-of-28 passes for 252 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans. Making his first start for the Giants, McCarthy did not throw a touchdown or turn the ball over. He was able to find Malik Nabers early and often. He'll be a QB2 in superflex and 2-QB leagues moving forward.

items.h: Little production in OT win
items.s: McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards and no touchdowns or interceptions in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans. He added one yard on his only carry. Making his first start of the season, McCarthy was efficient in getting the Giants into position to score, but all four of their touchdowns came on the ground -- including a one-yard plunge by the man he replaced under center, Jameis Winston, in the second quarter. The victory alone was enough to keep McCarthy in the starting job, and after a bye he'll gear up for a Week 9 clash with the Eagles.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy Faces Tough Test Against Texans
items.s: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy was named the starter for their Week 7 matchup against the Houston Texans. After Jameis Winston struggled mightily in their 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints, McCarthy entered with 11:25 left in the fourth quarter and nearly led a historic comeback. The former first-round pick completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards, with one touchdown and one interception, and added 26 rushing yards. With the Saints playing soft coverage while holding a three-score lead, McCarthy diced them up, throwing for the most yards in a fourth quarter in franchise history. Now, he faces the treacherous Texans defense, which allowed the third-fewest fantasy points to a…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy to have 100 percent of playbook to work with
items.s: Giants OC Matt Nagy said J.J. McCarthy will have 100 percent of the play book to work with. McCarthy will get his first official start with the Giants. He'll be a QB2 play in a tough matchup against the Texans.

items.h: Confirmed to start Week 7
items.s: McCarthy will start at quarterback in Week 7 against Houston, coach John Harbaugh confirmed Wednesday. Things had been trending in this direction after McCarthy's impressive performance in relief of Jameis Winston in Week 6. Harbaugh made it official Wednesday afternoon as the team looks to see what it has in the recently acquired McCarthy. He completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards with a touchdown and a pick and had a pair of 40-yard completions in limited action against the Saints.

items.h: J.J. McCarthy starting for Giants in Week 7
items.s: J.J. McCarthy will be the Giants starter in their Week 7 matchup against Houston. The Giants have benched Jameis Winston in favor of the younger McCarthy, who came to the Giants via trade with Minnesota a couple weeks ago. McCarthy has his flaws, some of which were on full display in the Giants comeback attempt against the Saints. However, he also nearly brought them back to a win, so it sounds like the coaching staff has decided the benefits outweigh the risks. Expect Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely to continue to be force fed targets, with smaller shares going to Malachi Fields, Darnell Mooney, and the like.

items.h: Headed for Week 7 start
items.s: The Giants plan to start McCarthy at quarterback in Sunday's game against the Texans, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports. McCarthy looks set to make his first start of the season and his first as a member of the Giants after an impressive showing in relief of the struggling Jameis Winston during Sunday's 34-27 loss to New Orleans. After checking into the game with the Giants down 24 points with just under 12 minutes remaining in the fourth quarter, McCarthy proceeded to lead a furious comeback bid. He completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards, one touchdown and one interception in less than a quarter of action ,and he led the Giants into the red zone for a potential game-tying score in the…

items.h: Giants Plan to Start J.J. McCarthy in Week 7
items.s: The New York Giants plan to start quarterback J.J. McCarthy on Sunday against the Houston Texans in Week 7, a source told Jeremy Fowler of ESPN. McCarthy took over for veteran QB Jameis Winston on Sunday in the Week 6 loss to the New Orleans Saints and immediately threw an interception, but overall he did some good things and made things interesting to close out the second half. The 23-year-old went 11-for-21 passing for 243 yards with one touchdown and one interception. It was enough to convince the Giants' coaching staff that McCarthy deserves to start this weekend in Houston. There is no guarantee that the former 10th overall pick by the Minnesota Vikings in 2024 from Michigan will…

items.h: J.J. McCarthy a Waiver Target as he Looks to Seize Starting Job
items.s: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy's fantasy football value hit rock bottom when he lost out to Kyler Murray in Minnesota earlier this year, but the New York Giants swung a trade for him after Jaxson Dart's season-ending knee injury, and now he potentially has a chance to start under center for the G-Men in the Week 7 contest against the Houston Texans. The 23-year-old replaced a struggling Jameis Winston on Sunday against the New Orleans Saints and made the game interesting, going 11-for-21 passing for 243 yards, one touchdown, and one interception. The Giants have not revealed their plan at the QB position yet for this weekend against Houston, but there have been rumors that it will be McCarthy…

items.h: McCarthy replaced starter Jameis Winston in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints, completing 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards and one touchdown with one interception.
items.s: After Winston tossed his second pick of the game, New Orleans turned the ensuing possession into a two-play touchdown drive to go ahead 34-10. McCarthy stepped in and immediately threw an interception of his own on his first drive, but he settled in after that and led the Giants on three straight scoring drives as they mounted a desperate, but ultimately unsuccessful, comeback. It's not clear which quarterback will get the start in Week 7 against the Texans, but head coach John Harbaugh may view the team's Week 8 bye as a better time to make a permanent switch to McCarthy.

items.h: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday he plans to keep using McCarthy in a change-of-pace role behind starting quarterback Jameis Winston in an effort to take advantage of McCarthy's scrambling ability, Jordan…
items.s: Acquired from the Vikings on Sept. 28, McCarthy has suited up for both of the Giants' ensuing two games but didn't make his team debut until this past Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Commanders. He ended up replacing Winston under center for five snaps, gaining two yards on two carries and having two of the plays wiped out by penalties. Despite the meager returns in his package of plays last week, McCarthy looks like he'll remain a marginal part of the game plan in Week 6 against the Saints. Harbaugh has given no indication that McCarthy will displace Winston as the team's starter anytime soon.

items.h: McCarthy is serving as the Giants No. 2 quarterback for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Jake Haener backed up Jameis Winston last week versus the Cardinals, but he's inactive as New York's third quarterback for Sunday's contest. The No. 2 job is now officially McCarthy's after he had a couple weeks to familiarize himself with a new playbook following his acquisition from the Vikings in late September. Winston remains the starter for now, but McCarthy seems likely to get a look at some point this year for the Giants.

items.h: The Giants acquired McCarthy from the Vikings on Monday in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round pick, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
items.s: The No. 10 overall pick in the 2024 NFL Draft, McCarthy had fallen out of favor in Minnesota and had dropped behind both Kyler Murray and Carson Wentz on the depth chart. The 23-year-old will get a fresh opportunity in New York, where he should at least settle in as the No. 2 quarterback behind Jameis Winston while Jaxson Dart (knee) is likely out for the season. Though Winston led the Giants to a 12-7 win over the Titans in his first start this past Sunday, he's completed just 25 of 49 pass attempts for 229 yards (4.7 YPA) while playing nearly two full games. Another underwhelming…

items.h: McCarthy (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Vikings' emergency third quarterback against the Packers on Sunday, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
items.s: McCarthy lost out to Kyler Murray for the starting job in training camp, and head coach Kevin O'Connell opted to go with Carson Wentz as the backup in Week 1. As the emergency third quarterback, McCarthy is not allowed to play Sunday unless both Murray and Wentz are removed from the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

items.h: Head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Wednesday that McCarthy will serve as the Vikings' third-string quarterback for Sunday's season opener versus the Packers.
items.s: After losing out in the battle with newcomer Kyler Murray for the starting job prior to the preseason opener, McCarthy will plummet all the way to third on the depth chart heading into Week 1, with Carson Wentz settling in as Murray's top backup. O'Connell said that he considers the No. 2 quarterback "a week-to-week thing," so McCarthy could leapfrog Wentz on the depth chart in future games depending on how he performs during practice. In any case, the fact that the 23-year-old McCarthy has to battle for the No. 2 job less than three years after being selected with the No. 10 overall pick in…

items.h: McCarthy (ankle) has practiced in full this week, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Vikings GM Nolan Teasley said Wednesday that he also expects McCarthy to remain with the team this season, whether it's as Kyler Murray's direct backup or the QB3 behind Carson Wentz. Coach Kevin O'Connell seems to want more time with the 2024 first-rounder in an effort to continue to develop the 23-year-old. Across two preseason games this summer, McCarthy completed nine of 17 passes for 115 yards.

items.h: McCarthy (ankle) remains on the 53-man roster for the Vikings, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: There was talk leading up to cut-down day that McCarthy could be traded or even released, but he will remain with Minnesota for the time being. Kyler Murray will open the season as the starting quarterback for the Vikings, and either McCarthy or Carson Wentz will back him up.
